findings.finding: Insights: BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ BC=Fₙ₊₂, s−b=Fₙ, s−c=Fₙ₊₁. K is A‑mixtilinear touchpoint; K′ is its reflection across EF. Condition “B,K,K′,N cyclic” fixes triangle shape for each ratio t=CD/BD. Compute NB/NE and BT (intersection of circle through B,K tangent to BN with BC) in terms of sides; ratio R=(CT·NB)/(BT·NE) simplifies to a function f(t). Max over admissible shapes gives aₙ=f(t). As n→∞, t→φ (golden ratio). Hence α=limₙ→∞f(t)=p+√q. Finally compute ⌊p^{q^p}⌋ mod 99991. Pitfalls: ensure correct use of incircle lengths, mixtilinear geometry, and cyclic condition; verify that aₙ is unique for each t, so max= value.

Insights: BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ a=BC=Fₙ₊₂, b−c=Fₙ₋₁, b=s−Fₙ, c=s−Fₙ₊₁ (s free>Fₙ₊₂). K = second meet of (AFE) & Ω. Condition “KNK′B cyclic” ⇔ center O of circle (B,K) tangent to BN lies on EF ⇒ O=EF∩⊥BN at B ⇒ distance OK=OB gives equation linking s. Compute ratio R=(CT·NB)/(BT·NE) via power of point & similar triangles; R depends only on s. Maximize R under cyclic equation → limit α as n→∞ (even n) = p+√q (p,q rational). Finally evaluate ⌊p^{q^p}⌋ mod 99991. Pitfalls: mis‑identifying cyclic condition, ignoring symmetry of K′, forgetting NB is tangent length (NB²=power). Use Fibonacci asymptotics (Fₙ₊₁/Fₙ→φ) to simplify α.

Insights: BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ BC=Fₙ₊₂, AB‑AC=Fₙ₋₁. Let AB=c, AC=c+Fₙ₋₁. Impose cyclic K‑N‑K′‑B (K from (AFE)∩Ω, K′ its EF‑mirror, N foot from D to EF). Solve for c numerically → unique root per n. Compute ratio R=CT·NB/(BT·NE). R converges (even n) to φ³=2+√5. Hence α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5. Desired value =⌊2^{5²}⌋ mod 99991 =2^{25} mod 99991 = 57447. Pitfalls: ensure correct cyclic test (B on circumcircle of K,N,K′), use correct foot/reflect formulas, handle only the non‑A intersection for K.

Insights: BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ BD/CD = rₙ → φ⁻¹. With a=BC=1 (scale), b = c + (1–r)/(1+r). Cyclic condition K‑N‑K'‑B forces a single‑parameter family; numeric solving shows max of R = (CT·NB)/(BT·NE) → 2+√5. Hence α=2+√5 (p=2,q=5). Compute floor(2^{5²})=2^{25}=33 554 432; 33 554 432 mod 99991 = **57447**.
